concept.heading: Core Patterns
bullets: **DFS (recursive):** Most tree problems. Return values up, pass info down.
**BST property:** left < root < right. Inorder = sorted.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.keyInsight: Swap left and right children at every node, recursively.

code.python:
def invertTree(root):
    if not root:
        return None
    root.left, root.right = root.right, root.left
    invertTree(root.left)
    invertTree(root.right)
    return root

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.keyInsight: Diameter through a node = left_height + right_height. Track global max while computing heights.

problems.title: Balanced Binary Tree
problems.keyInsight: Return -1 if subtree is unbalanced. Otherwise return height. Unbalanced = height difference > 1.

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of BST
problems.keyInsight: In BST, if both p and q are smaller, go left. Both bigger, go right. Otherwise, current node IS the LCA (split point).

problems.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
problems.keyInsight: BFS level by level. The last node in each level is visible from the right.

problems.title: Count Good Nodes in Binary Tree
problems.keyInsight: A node is "good" if no node on the path from root has a greater value. Pass the max value seen so far down the recursion.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.keyInsight: Each node must be within a valid range (low, high). Going left, update high. Going right, update low.

problems.title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
problems.keyInsight: Inorder traversal of BST gives sorted order. The kth element in inorder is the answer.

problems.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder
problems.keyInsight: Preorder[0] = root. Find root in inorder to split left/right subtrees. Use hashmap for O(1) index lookup in inorder.

problems.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
problems.keyInsight: At each node, the max path THROUGH it = node.val + max(left, 0) + max(right, 0). Return the max single-branch path upward. Track global max.

problems.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
problems.keyInsight: Preorder DFS with null markers. Serialize: "1,2,N,N,3,4,N,N,5,N,N". Deserialize: consume tokens one by one in same preorder fashion.
